ceu: ✦ The trine between Mercury and Uranus

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The trine between Mercury and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.
